components.name: Primary Pill
components.css: .ds-pill { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:56px; min-width:220px; padding:0 32px; border:0; border-radius:980px; background:#0071e3; color:#fff; font:400 19px/1 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Inter, sans-serif; letter-spacing:-0.022em; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color .2s cubic-bezier(.25,.1,.25,1), transform .2s; } .ds-pill:hover { background:#0077ed; } .ds-pill:active { transform:scale(.98); } .ds-pill:focus-visible { outline:3px solid rgba(0,113,227,.32); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Secondary Pill
components.description: Outlined pill for the follow-up action, 'Validar outro deck'.
components.css: .ds-pill-secondary { min-height:44px; padding:0 22px; border:1px solid #0066cc; border-radius:980px; background:transparent; color:#0066cc; font:400 17px/1 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Inter, sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color .2s, color .2s; } .ds-pill-secondary:hover { background:#0071e3; border-color:#0071e3; color:#fff; } .ds-pill-secondary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid rgba(0,113,227,.32); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: iOS-style filter and view switch with a sliding thumb.
components.css: .ds-seg { position:relative; isolation:isolate; display:inline-flex; gap:2px; padding:2px; border-radius:9px; background:rgba(0,0,0,.06); font:500 13px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-seg-thumb { position:absolute; z-index:-1; top:2px; bottom:2px; left:2px; width:72px; border-radius:7px; background:#fff; box-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.12); transition:transform .32s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), width .32s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-seg-opt { min-height:30px; padding:0 12px; border:0; border-radius:7px; background:transparent; color:#1d1d1f; font:inherit; cursor:pointer; } .ds-seg-opt span { color:#6e6e73; } .ds-seg-opt.is-active span { color:#1d1d1f; } .ds-seg-opt:hover:not(.is-active) { background:rgba(0,0,0,.04); } .ds-seg-opt:focus-visible { outline:3px solid rgba(0,113,227,.32); }

components.name: Glass Tile
components.description: Frosted container for composer, stats, problems and cards.
components.html:
Problemas encontrados

Mana Crypt — Esta carta é banida no Duel Commander.
components.css: .ds-glass-bg { padding:32px; background:radial-gradient(closest-side, rgba(0,113,227,.08), transparent) , #f5f5f7; } .ds-glass { padding:28px; border-radius:28px; background:rgba(255,255,255,.72); -webkit-backdrop-filter:saturate(180%) blur(28px); backdrop-filter:saturate(180%) blur(28px); border:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.06); box-shadow:0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.9) inset, 0 20px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.06); font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Inter, sans-serif; color:#1d1d1f; } .ds-glass h3 { margin:0 0 8px; font-size:24px; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:-0.015em; } .ds-glass p { margin:0; color:#6e6e73; font-size:15px; }

components.name: Search Input
components.description: Commander field with leading search icon.
components.html: <label class="ds-input"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="17" height="17" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="6.5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8"/><path d="m16 16 4.5 4.5" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg><input placeholder="Ex.: Atraxa, Grand Unifier"></label>
components.css: .ds-input { position:relative; display:block; width:320px; } .ds-input svg { position:absolute; left:14px; top:50%; transform:translateY(-50%); color:#6e6e73; } .ds-input input { width:100%; box-sizing:border-box; height:48px; padding:0 16px 0 40px; border:1px solid #d2d2d7; border-radius:12px; background:rgba(255,255,255,.86); font:16px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Inter, sans-serif; color:#1d1d1f; outline:none; caret-color:#0071e3; transition:border-color .2s, box-shadow .2s; } .ds-input input:focus { border-color:#0071e3; box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(0,113,227,.32); }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Card state pill; the only place semantic color appears.
components.html: Legal Banida Só no deck Não encontrada
components.css: .ds-badge { display:inline-flex; padding:3px 9px; border-radius:980px; font:500 12px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-legal { color:#248a3d; background:rgba(52,199,89,.12); } .ds-banned { color:#d70015; background:rgba(255,59,48,.1); } .ds-cmd { color:#b25000; background:rgba(255,149,0,.14); } .ds-unknown { color:#6e6e73; background:rgba(0,0,0,.06); }

components.name: Grid Deck Card
components.description: Card art tile in the type-grouped grid; banned cards get a crisp red ring.
components.css: .ds-deck-card { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:10px; width:150px; padding:0; border:0; background:none; text-align:left; cursor:pointer; font:500 14px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Inter, sans-serif; color:#1d1d1f; } .ds-art { position:relative; display:block; aspect-ratio:488/680; border-radius:4.8%/3.5%; background:linear-gradient(160deg,#3a3a3c,#1c1c1e); box-shadow:0 6px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.14); transition:transform .35s cubic-bezier(.25,.1,.25,1); } .ds-deck-card:hover .ds-art { transform:translateY(-4px) scale(1.02); } .ds-deck-card.is-banned .ds-art { box-shadow:0 0 0 3px #d70015, 0 6px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.14); } .ds-qty { position:absolute; top:8px; left:8px; padding:2px 8px; border-radius:980px; background:rgba(0,0,0,.78); color:#fff; font-size:12px; font-weight:600; } .ds-deck-card:focus-visible { outline:3px solid rgba(0,113,227,.32); outline-offset:4px; border-radius:8px; }

narrative.northStar: An Apple product page that happens to be a working tool
narrative.overview: The verdict is the headline: after validation, 'Deck válido' or 'Deck inválido' is set at hero scale with one specific summary line. The material is frosted glass over a single static field of soft blue light; light mode is neutral #f5f5f7 with white glass, dark mode is black with dark glass. One action blue; green, red and orange only mark card state.
keyCharacteristics: Frosted 52px nav, two-tone 80px headline, composer above the fold, one blue pill
Glass tiles with hairline rims over one static ambient light
iOS segmented controls with a sliding thumb
Cards grouped by type in list and grid
Motion explains state: theme reveal, card morph, drawn verdict icon

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: Blue means you can act here; it never marks state or decoration.

rules.name: The One Light Rule
rules.body: One ambient light, static. No second hue, no drifting gradients under glass.

rules.name: The No Glow Rule
rules.body: Banned cards get a crisp 2px red ring with a neutral shadow, never a colored bloom.

rules.name: The Verdict Rule
rules.body: Only the hero headline and the verdict use display size.

dos: Do keep the verdict the largest thing on the results screen.
Do give every count a unit that matches what it counts.
Do keep the ambient light static and singular.
Do theme selection, caret, scrollbar and focus ring from the palette.
Do escape every Scryfall or user string before innerHTML.
donts: Don't add colored glows, gradient text, purple fields or neon accents.
Don't put an eyebrow above a heading or number the sections.
Don't use emoji or Unicode glyphs as icons.
Don't make the whole results section a live region.
Don't animate anything that sits under backdrop-filter.
